title: Join Sight Sciences at AAO 2026 in New Orleans
summary: Sight Sciences is excited to bring innovation, expertise, and hands-on learning to this year’s American Academy of Ophthalmology Annual Meeting.
body_markdown:
Sight Sciences is excited to bring innovation, expertise, and hands-on learning to this year’s American Academy of Ophthalmology Annual Meeting. Join us for expert-led discussions, live demonstrations, and peer-to-peer connections—all designed to elevate your clinical knowledge and skills.


## Visit us at Booth #1237


### Explore our Technologies


Stop by during exhibit hours to experience the newest innovations in our portfolio: **OMNI® Ultra Surgical System** and **TearCare® Clearance Assistant Plus™** . Visit us to see OMNI® Edge Surgical System, SION® Surgical Instrument and TearCare® System. Engage in hands-on demos and get your questions answered—whether it’s about clinical collaboration, reimbursement, training certification, or more.


#### Exhibit Hours:


- Saturday, October 10 9:00 a.m.– 5:00 p.m.
- Sunday, October 11 9:00 a.m.– 5:00 p.m.
- Monday, October 12 9:00 a.m. – 3:30 p.m.


[Questions? Contact us →](https://www.sightsciences.com/us/contact-us/)


### TearCare® Clearance Experience Sessions


See TearCare in action with a live demo at Booth #1237, then hear from your peers in exclusive sessions sharing real-world insights on integrating TearCare into clinical practice. Learn how to optimize outcomes, navigate the evolving interventional dry eye landscape, and unlock new opportunities in MGD care.


**Saturday, October 10**


- 9:00 am – 10:00 am • **Nandini Venkateswaran, MD**
- 12:00 pm – 1:00 pm • **Preeya Gupta, MD**
- 3:00 pm – 4:00 pm • **Kunjal Modi, MD**


**Sunday, October 11**


- 9:00 am – 10:00 am • **Richard Chu, DO**
- 12:00 pm – 1:00 pm • **Brandon Ayres, MD**
- 3:00 pm – 4:00 pm • **Mina Farahani, MD**


### ASOA Live! IG Dinner Series


**Three Practices, Three Stories: The Why Behind Interventional Glaucoma**


Join us for an engaging, case-based discussion exploring the real-world adoption of interventional glaucoma across three distinct practices. Ben Seals, MBA, Nate Schwartz. DO, and Charles H. Williamson Jr. will share how they partnered with physicians, navigated different practice models, and drove meaningful change in glaucoma care.


- **Date:** Thursday, October 8
- **Time:** 6:30 pm –8:30 pm
- **Location:** Tableau, 616 St. Peter Street


### ASOA’s 40 under 40 (ish) Awards


Administrative Eyecare’s **40 Under 40ish** is a special program to recognize the excellence and contributions of up-and-coming administrators. The 40 under 40ish list is made up of practice leaders under 45 years old who have demonstrated expertise and impact in the field. The group, chosen by their peers, will be featured across multiple *Administrative Eyecare* platforms.


Sight Sciences’ very own Matt Gibson will be serving as guest DJ at the **Honoree Reception at the 2026 American Academy of Ophthalmology (AAO) Annual Meeting.**


- **Date:** Friday, October 9
- **Time:** 5:00 pm –6:00 pm
- **Location:** Hilton New Orleans Riverside


### IX EYEcon Appreciation Reception


At Sight Sciences, our IX EYEcons are at the heart of everything we do. Join us for a special evening dedicated to celebrating your partnership, recognizing your impact, and introducing our newest innovations.


Enjoy great food, drinks, and meaningful conversations with colleagues and the Sight Sciences team. We look forward to thanking you in person and celebrating together.


Please feel free to come and go as your schedule allows, and kindly RSVP below.


[RSVP →](https://cvent.me/DAVdgq)


- **Date:** Saturday, October 10
- **Time:** 6:00 pm –8:00 pm
- **Location:** Sazerac House


### MIGS Skills Transfer Lab


OMNI will be featured in two official AAO CME-accredited MIGS Skills Transfer Courses. These hands-on labs offer a unique opportunity to practice using a variety of MIGS devices, including OMNI.


**Saturday, October 10**


- Event: AAO Skills Lab
- Time: 3:00 pm – 5:00 pm
- Location: LAB117A – 354


**Sunday, October 11**


- Event: AAO Skills Lab
- Time: 8:00 am – 10:00 am
- Location: LAB117B – 354


### Transformative, Interventional Technologies


At Sight Sciences, we are reimagining eyecare with transformative technology and an interventional mindset.


We have embarked on a journey to reimagine the landscape of eyecare. Our mission is clear: to transform possibility into practice with accessible, interventional technologies and trusted partnerships with eyecare providers.


We envision a future where innovations are not only groundbreaking but are also employed at the earliest stages of disease progression, ensuring safe and unprecedented progress in the field of vision health.


[About Sight Sciences →](https://www.sightsciences.com/us/about-us/)

**Important Information**


All the physicians are paid consultants of Sight Sciences. These events are neither sponsored nor endorsed by AAO.


The OMNI® Surgical System is indicated for canaloplasty (microcatheterization and transluminal viscodilation of Schlemm’s canal) followed by trabeculotomy (cutting of trabecular meshwork) to reduce intraocular pressure in adult patients with primary open-angle glaucoma. Visit[omnisurgical.com/ifu](https://www.sightsciences.com/us/omni/instructions-for-use/) for the indications for use, contraindications, warnings, and potential adverse events. The SION® Surgical Instrument is a sterile, single use, manually operated device used in ophthalmic surgical procedures to excise trabecular meshwork. Visit[sionsurgical.com/ifu](https://www.sightsciences.com/us/sion/instructionsforuse/) for the indications for use, contraindications, warnings, and potential adverse events. The Sight Sciences TearCare System® is a thermal-activated gland expression therapy that improves meibomian gland function in adult patients with evaporative dry eye disease due to meibomian gland dysfunction (MGD), when used in conjunction with manual expression of the meibomian glands. Please see[Instructions for Use](https://www.sightsciences.com/us/tearcare/instructionsforuse/) or visit[TearCare.com](https://www.sightsciences.com/us/tearcare/) for Contraindications, Warnings, Precautions and Adverse Events.
